scope: Individual protections reviewed without a post-hoc percentage tolerance or average-gain offset.
timing_limitations: One descriptive pair per mode, interrupted reusable prior phases and a separate cold parent 200K start. No statistical noninferiority, no regression upper bound, no assertion that negative points are noise.
resources: 48 complete windows; no q4t swap; sampled GPU/EMC frequencies unchanged in these windows. MemAvailable is system-wide and is not a hard physical allocation bound.
